name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Limit seasonal particles to Media Bar and My Media with scroll and resize tracking. Hide password reset on the personal profile while keeping save and admin reset. Preserve the configured library order. Desktop assets are separate downloads; Jelly+ 0.1.5.0 updates its seasonal script loader.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
